role: Reviewer/collaborator; substantive revision of Paper 1 only
authorization: User explicitly requested upload of code and review/progression of the attached SSCD advice; prior authorization covers experiments and ongoing research archiving.
scope: Archive attachment and original branch source byte-exact; do not merge or overwrite the source branch.
Reproduce source endpoint failure; correct the signed-KL identity in review, without silently rewriting original proof.
Implement a numerically validated compact signed-Watson domain theta in [-20,20], with explicit domain checks and dependence-budget boundaries; do not claim arbitrary endpoint support.
Distinguish finite-template optimization from the continuous energy sphere. For effective parameter dimension two, supply analytical angular discretization bounds and outer interval bounds.
Benchmark aligned expansion, rotating expansion, a combined conflicting family (IID fallback), and three existing supplementary common-G models. Include IID explicitly.

limits: Analytical optimization bounds use floating-point evaluated norms/moments and explicit padding, not formal outward-rounded interval arithmetic. A nonzero remaining gap is reported if search cap is reached.
